notes: White flag with acclimatized worker — continuous work.
White flag with unacclimatized worker — 50/10 split.
Green flag with acclimatized worker — 50/10 split.
Green flag with unacclimatized worker — 40/20 split.
Yellow flag with acclimatized worker — reassess after 6 cycles.
Yellow flag with unacclimatized worker — reassess after 4 cycles.
Red flag with acclimatized worker — reassess after 4 cycles.
Red flag with unacclimatized worker — cease work and move to refuge.
Black flag with acclimatized worker — reassess every cycle.
Black flag with unacclimatized worker — cease work and move to refuge.
